nodes.label: Proposed Signed URL Revocation Window
nodes.description: After unbind, new URL authorization is denied immediately; previously signed media URLs expire by short TTL, recommended no more than five minutes.
nodes.rationale: Distinguish immediate application authorization revocation from the finite residual lifetime of previously signed object URLs.

nodes.label: Required Template Composition IMG01 IMG06
nodes.description: At least six configurable styles with crop/date/text/stickers; 1-image poster, 2-4-image collage, 5-9-image cover; immutable originals and versioned derivatives.
nodes.rationale: Controlled composition gives stable results and predictable cost and privacy review; generative imagery is deferred.

nodes.label: Proposed Deployment Topology
nodes.description: At least two stateless API replicas behind gateway/WAF, separate worker groups, highly available MySQL/Redis, private original/derived storage, managed queue and dead-letter queue.
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1.pdf

nodes.label: Required Interactions INT01 INT06
nodes.description: Authorized shared moments, six fixed reactions, one reaction per user/moment, own-deletable single-level comments up to 300 characters, in-app messages, reminder preferences and feedback.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md

nodes.label: Pending Design Decisions TBD01 TBD15
nodes.description: Cloud vendor, media limits, joint pet confirmation timing, interaction retention, review provider, backup/delete SLA, capacity, public share revocation, export scope, app stack/auth/push/deep links and release constraints remain subject to confirmation.
nodes.rationale: TBD-10 leaves personal data export MVP versus v1.2 unresolved; distinguish these recommendations from confirmed product scope.
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1.pdf

nodes.label: Proposed Release Gates and Recovery Guards
nodes.description: Contract/migration/security scans, unit/integration/E2E and real-device checks, 1/10/50/100 percent rollout, rollback compatibility, privacy consistency and restore-time authorization/tombstone checks.
nodes.norm_label: proposed release gates and recovery guards
nodes.rationale: Prevent deleted data or old relationship permissions from returning after backup recovery or incompatible releases.
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1.pdf

nodes.label: Proposed North Star Metric
nodes.description: Count paired couples with at least three valid shared moments in the last 30 days; valid moments contain media or over 20 characters and are published, undeleted and successfully processed.
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0.pdf
nodes.source_location: p.4 Section 1.5; p.28 Effective Moment Definition

nodes.label: Required Time Views TIM01 TIM05
nodes.description: Day/week/month/year/custom views, date anchors, server-side time and authorization filters, stable secondary ordering and factual gentle statistics.
nodes.rationale: Make memories easy to revisit without diagnosing relationship quality from record counts or mood tags.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md

nodes.label: Proposed Signed Timeline Cursor
nodes.description: HMAC-protected occurred_at/created_at/id cursor binds normalized query and actor scope; own and shared SQL ranges are filtered before UNION ALL.
nodes.rationale: Avoid pagination drift, duplicates and private-content leakage while handling timezone boundaries.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md

nodes.label: Proposed Channel Adapter
nodes.description: Isolate channel-specific authentication, WeChat subscriptions, APNs/Android push and deep links; app identity binding remains subject to review.
nodes.rationale: Channel differences must not duplicate domain rules or bypass resource authorization.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md

nodes.label: Proposed Leased Background Jobs
nodes.description: Leases and heartbeats for processing/generation, bounded retries and dead letters; cleanup and unbind finalization remain retryable and frozen on failure.
nodes.rationale: Worker crashes and duplicate delivery must not duplicate rewards/assets or reopen a frozen relationship.
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1.pdf

nodes.label: Proposed Deterministic Template Rendering
nodes.description: Low-resolution client preview and final worker rendering use immutable template version, crop/overlay parameters and params_hash; original publication survives rendering failure.
nodes.rationale: Combine fast previews with consistent final outputs and preserve unmodified originals.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md

nodes.label: Product Requirements PRD v1.0
nodes.description: MVP initiation draft dated 2026-07-02 for adult couples; P0/P1/P2 denote required/planned priorities, not implementation status.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md

nodes.label: Proposed Unified Domain API
nodes.description: MiniProgram and planned iOS/Android clients must share one domain API and business data at /api/v1.
nodes.rationale: Prevent identity, relationships, permissions, media, pet and recap rules from diverging across clients.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md

nodes.label: Required Creator Uploader Ownership Policy
nodes.description: Moment ownership stays with creator, media with uploader; current couple receives time-limited access, pet freezes and couple recap stops after unbind.
nodes.rationale: Separate access from ownership so relationship termination and deletion preserve each person's own content while ending mutual access.
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0.pdf

nodes.label: Required Annual Recap REV01 REV09
nodes.description: Natural-year candidates, manual low-material option, PRIVATE exclusion, sensitive opt-in, editable chapters, story pages/paginated long images, async jobs, share disclosure and deletable versions.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md

nodes.label: Required Privacy SAFE01 SAFE06
nodes.description: On-demand consent, current server authorization for records/media/recaps, moderation and appeals, immutable privacy audit, traceable deletion and short media URLs.
nodes.rationale: Protect private shared memories across lists, messages, links, derived works, unbinding, deletion and backup recovery.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md

nodes.label: Required Cloud Pet PET01 PET07
nodes.description: One couple pet, three species, joint first-adoption confirmation, daily feed/play once each per actor, capped reward settlement, ten nondecreasing levels, 30-day log and freeze on unbind.
nodes.rationale: Offer shared feedback without death, missed-day penalties or partner contribution rankings.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md

nodes.label: Proposed AccessScope Authorization
nodes.description: Owner access or SHARED plus matching current couple, active membership and PAIRED status; media/recap inherit parent authorization; deny by default.
nodes.rationale: A URL or client-side hidden control is not an authorization boundary; reauthorize before returning cached content.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md

nodes.label: Deferred Personal Export SAFE07
nodes.description: P1 personal-data export of creator-owned records and uploader-owned media using an expiring encrypted download package; roadmap places export in v1.2.
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0.pdf

nodes.label: Planned Light Tasks PET08
nodes.description: P1: at most three daily record/respond/interact tasks, skippable and without cumulative missed-day pressure.
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0.pdf

nodes.label: Proposed Media Processing Lifecycle
nodes.description: PENDING_UPLOAD to UPLOADED to SCANNING to READY/BLOCKED/FAILED to DELETED; validate owner, object size/hash and callbacks; strip EXIF in display copies.
nodes.rationale: Only READY media may be read by the other partner; failed media remain recoverable and owner-only.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md

nodes.label: Proposed GenerationJob
nodes.description: QUEUED/RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED task states with unique type/input/version/params, retries, lease, progress and error code.
nodes.rationale: Reuse tasks and fixed input versions to prevent duplicate outputs, side effects or charging.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md

nodes.label: Proposed Modular Monolith
nodes.description: Recommended Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.x modular monolith, with workers in the same repository and separate processes.
nodes.rationale: Simplify MVP transactions and delivery while preserving domain boundaries for later scaling.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md

nodes.label: Proposed MySQL Redis Private Storage Baseline
nodes.description: Recommended MySQL 8.0 InnoDB for shared domain facts, Redis 7 for sessions/rate limits/idempotency/cache, and private object storage with authorized CDN.
nodes.norm_label: proposed mysql redis private storage baseline
nodes.rationale: Keep relationship authorization strongly consistent and avoid permanent cloud secrets or public media URLs on clients.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md

nodes.label: Required MVP Record Respond Revisit Recap Loop
nodes.description: Record a moment, partner responds, both revisit time views, recap or pet feedback encourages further recording.
nodes.norm_label: required mvp record respond revisit recap loop
nodes.rationale: Preserve pairing, basic recording, shared visibility, revisiting, privacy and unbinding if resources require scope cuts.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md

nodes.label: Required On Demand Consent and Share Disclosure
nodes.description: Request media/save/reminder permissions in the action context; show names/dates/photos/text before sharing; rejection preserves a useful fallback.
nodes.norm_label: required on demand consent and share disclosure
nodes.rationale: User consent and export disclosure must remain explicit; external reminders are optional to core usability.

nodes.label: Proposed OpenAPI Contract
nodes.description: Single OpenAPI 3.x contract, generated DTO/SDK, stable errors, additive evolution and a compatibility window covering store review delays.
nodes.rationale: Avoid hand-maintained client DTO drift while allowing independent client releases.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md

nodes.description: Technical review draft dated 2026-07-02; recommendations and requirements are not evidence of implemented features.

nodes.description: Unbind transaction commits FROZEN and removes active membership before returning; asynchronous finalization must never restore mutual access.
nodes.rationale: Make privacy effective for new authenticated requests immediately while allowing expensive isolation and deletion to recover.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md

nodes.label: Proposed Orphan Upload Cleanup
nodes.description: Uploaded but incomplete objects: proposed cleanup after 24h; completed unattached assets: owner-only and cleanup/reuse after 7d; outbox replays missed processing.
nodes.rationale: Recover partial uploads without exposing unused assets or retaining abandoned objects indefinitely.
nodes.source_file: doc/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1.pdf

nodes.label: Proposed RecapSnapshot
nodes.description: Versioned selected moment IDs, media versions, text, ordering, config and rendering parameters; PRIVATE hard exclusion, sensitive tags default soft exclusion, disclosure manifest.
nodes.rationale: Stable input prevents original edits during generation from creating inconsistent output; export rechecks authorization.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md

nodes.label: Required Pairing ACC01 ACC09
nodes.description: WeChat login, independent unpaired use, at most one active couple, hashed one-use 24h invitations, explicit acceptance, single-party unbind, ownership isolation and deletion status.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md

nodes.label: Proposed Asynchronous Worker
nodes.description: Workers perform moderation, media processing, deterministic rendering, notification and cleanup; execution must be idempotent.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md

nodes.label: Proposed Transactional Outbox
nodes.description: Write business state, audit and outbox_event in one transaction; publisher may repeat delivery and consumers deduplicate by event_id.
nodes.rationale: Recover after crashes without placing slow object-storage or queue calls inside business transactions.
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_多端产品_技术详细设计说明书_v1.1_fb8bab77.md
